en.headline: Centre for Health Protection investigates new mpox case, suggests temporary venue closure
en.dek: A 39-year-old man who developed a rash and tested positive for mpox is in stable condition in isolation; the centre recommended temporary closure of a Mong Kok premises he visited during the incubation period.
body: The Centre for Health Protection said it is investigating a new confirmed mpox case involving a 39-year-old man.

The patient began developing a rash on his right foot, face, back and buttocks from 5 October. He saw a private doctor on 8 October and was referred the next day to Yan Chai Hospital for isolation treatment. Laboratory testing confirmed the presence of the mpox virus. He is now in stable condition and has been transferred to Princess Margaret Hospital for continued isolation treatment.

According to the patient, he visited a premises named Hutong on Shanghai Street in Mong Kok multiple times during the incubation period and had high-risk sexual contacts with strangers there. The centre, together with police, conducted an on-site investigation and provided health education to staff, none of whom have shown symptoms so far. As a precaution, the centre recommended that the premises close temporarily from Monday.

The centre noted that Hong Kong has recorded 22 mpox cases since August, accounting for about 70 per cent of the year's total of 31 cases. All patients have been male and reported high-risk sexual behaviour; most had not been vaccinated. Genetic analysis suggested some shared sequences, pointing to possible common sources and multiple transmission chains within the men who have sex with men community. The centre urged anyone who visited the premises on or after 14 September, especially those with high-risk contacts, to call the hotline 2125 2373 for health assessment.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心調查新增猴痘個案 建議旺角處所暫時關閉
zh.dek: 一名39歲男子出現紅疹並確診猴痘，情況穩定正接受隔離治療；中心建議他潛伏期曾多次到訪的旺角處所即日起暫時關閉。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心表示，正調查一宗新增猴痘確診個案，涉及一名39歲男子。
患者自10月5日起先後於右腳、面部、背部及臀部出現紅疹。他於10月8日到私家診所求診，翌日獲轉介到仁濟醫院入院接受隔離治療。臨床樣本經化驗後證實對猴痘病毒呈陽性反應。病人目前情況穩定，已轉往瑪嘉烈醫院繼續接受隔離治療。
根據病人資料，他於潛伏期內多次到訪旺角上海街一所名為「胡同」的處所，並與陌生男子有多次高風險性接觸。中心聯同警方到場調查，並為員工提供健康教育，所有員工至今無出現病徵。為審慎起見，中心建議該處所由即日起暫時關閉。
中心指出，本港自8月至今錄得22宗猴痘個案，佔今年累計31宗約七成。患者全屬男性並曾有高風險性行為，大部分未接種疫苗。基因分析顯示部分患者序列相同，相信可能有共同感染源頭，並在男男性接觸者群體中存在多條傳播鏈。中心呼籲上月14日或之後曾到訪相關處所的人士，特別是曾有高風險接觸者，盡快致電熱線2125 2373接受健康評估。
